Method of Attack: Encrypts files and deletes encrypted files after a certain amount of time (Jigsaw)
Uses creepy clown theme to scare victims (KillerLocker)
Uses Voldemort and snake Nagini theme as background (Nagini)
Displays a mask from Spirited Away anime in ransom note (Onyx)
Uses scary duck image to intimidate victims (Angry Duck)
Prevents computer from booting properly and displays a giant flashing green skull (Petya)
Impacted Systems: User files (encrypted and deleted by Jigsaw)
General computer systems targeted by ransomware
